{"hook":"At 1\,300 m in the Tupungato cordillera\, the Atamisque vineyard sits on a fossil riverbed of rolled stones and granite sand\, giving this Chardonnay the cut and salinity that most Mendoza whites lack. 30 % new French oak and full malolactic add the mealy\, hazelnut note that reads like a mini-Mersault on the nose.","wine_summary":"Atamisque was the first boutique project to plant above 1\,200 m in the Uco Valley back in 1999\, betting that altitude—not oak recipes—would keep Chardonnay fresh at 33 °S. The gamble paid off: the 2018 took Berliner Gold\, and the wine has quietly become a go-to on Buenos Aires steak-house lists that need a white with shoulders. Valle de Tupungato’s arid continental climate (250 mm rain\, 20 °C diurnal swing) locks in pH around 3.2\, so even after barrel fermentation the wine finishes with Chablis-like snap.","terroir_expression":"The vineyard lies on an old alluvial fan shed by the Tunuyán River; topsoil is 40 cm of granite gravel mixed with limestone pebbles dragged from the cordillera. Free-draining and low in organic matter\, the soil forces roots to dive 3 m for water\, shrinking berries and concentrating lime–quartz flavours that show up in the glass as a struck-stone note behind white peach. Cold katabatic winds roll down the mountains every night\, dropping temperature 15 °C and halting respiration so malic acid stays high.","vinification_summary":"Whole-cluster press at 0.6 bar to avoid phenolic drag\, then spontaneous yeasts in 228 L Burgundy barrels where the wine stays 10 months on fine lees; 30 % new oak gives hazelnut and clove while the remaining neutral wood lets the site speak. Full malolactic converts sharp malic to softer lactic acid\, adding butter but not fat because total acidity still clocks 6.2 g/L—higher than most California Chards.","food_pairing":"Nashville hot chicken sandwich—the wine’s acidity and subtle butter cut the cayenne oil while the barrel toast mirrors the fry batter. 
Baja fish tacos with lime crema—saline finish echoes sea breeze and the creamy element tames chili heat. 
Fine-dining match: butter-poached lobster with corn purée—oak-derived hazelnut marries the Maillai reaction in seared crustacean\, and the 13.5 % ABV keeps the palate lively. 
Goat-cheese and herb soufflé—high acid slices the chalky cheese while mealy oak picks up the browned top.","comparable_wines":"Catena Alta Chardonnay — same altitude range but more new oak and 1 g/L RS\, so Atamisque feels drier and leaner.
Lagar de Bezana Chardonnay Cachapoal — similar granitic soils in Chile\, yet warmer nights give fuller body; Atamisque shows fresher cut.","style_profile":"Medium-bodied barrel-fermented dryi Chardonnay with crisp mineral spine and hazelnut cream","cellar_recommendation":"Drink 2024–2028 for primary fruit; the wine does not need further aging. Store 12 °C\, 70 % RH\, away from light.","value_assessment":"USD 24–28 on U.S. shelves puts it in the crosshairs of Sonoma Coast and entry White Burgundy. Against Louis Jadot Mâcon-Villages at the same price it delivers more site character and 1 % lower alcohol; against La Crema Sonoma it shows half the dosage of oak chips and noticeably higher acidity. Worth it if you want Chablis tension with Mendoza ripeness.","market_position":"Buenos Aires parrillas list it at ARS 4\,500 (≈ USD 26) because somms need a white that can stand up to beef without turning to butter. Export focus is Canada\, Brazil and U.K. independents; collectors ignore it\, casual drinkers discover it in restaurants\, then buy retail for weekday roast chicken.","insider_take":"Most shoppers reach for Catena or Zuccardi when they want "serious" Mendoza Chard; Atamisque gives you 200 m more altitude and 30 % less new oak for the same money—meaning you taste stone instead of spice cupboard. Skip if you need tropical fruit bombs; buy by the case if you wish Sonoma Coast could keep its acidity at 14 % ABV.","aging_potential_years":5,"drinking_window_min_years":4,"drinking_window_max_years":8,"sensory":{"acidity":4,"tannin":1,"body":3,"sweetness":1,"alcohol":3,"color_intensity":"medium","aroma_intensity":"medium","finish_length":"long","complexity":"moderate","quality_level":"very_good"}}
